title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 11

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Why will the library close early?
tasks.audioText: The college library will close at four thirty this Friday because staff are checking the book catalogue. Students should return borrowed books before four o'clock. The study room on the second floor will remain open until six, but the library computers will not be available. You can use the computer room in Block B instead. Normal library hours begin again on Monday.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Where can students use a computer?
tasks.audioText: The college library will close at four thirty this Friday because staff are checking the book catalogue. Students should return borrowed books before four o'clock. The study room on the second floor will remain open until six, but the library computers will not be available. You can use the computer room in Block B instead. Normal library hours begin again on Monday.

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. Nadia has to prepare a short report about renewable energy. She searches the college library catalogue and finds two useful books. She writes down their titles and shelf numbers before going to the reading area. She uses the books to check facts, but she writes the report in her own words. At the end, she lists the sources she used. What does Nadia write down from the catalogue?
Reading 2. How does Nadia use information from the books?
options: She asks a friend to write the report
She checks facts and writes in her own words

tasks.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about Nadia's library research.
options: Nadia has found two useful books.

tasks.prompt: Choose TWO useful ways to make a short report reliable.
options: Copy an unknown website without checking it.
Remove facts that disagree with your opinion.

tasks.prompt: Complete with one word: 'A list of books and websites used in a report is a list of ___.'
A technical manual is not listed in the library catalogue. Which polite question should you ask the librarian?
options: Why do you hide the books?
Could you help me locate this book, please?

tasks.prompt: Put the research steps in the correct order.
options: Write the report in your own words
correctOrder: Write the report in your own words

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words describing how to find and use information for a college report. Include searching a catalogue, checking facts and recording sources.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: relevant content and completion of the task (0–2); clear organisation and sequence (0–2); understandable grammar and sentence structure (0–2); appropriate vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
